# cmake/CMakeLists.txt -- AUTO-GENERATED by `tur fetch`. Do not edit.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(SpiceDeps)

include(FetchContent)

option(TUR_FETCH_FORCE_FETCH "Bypass system find_package for :prefer-system deps" OFF)

# libpq
if (NOT TUR_FETCH_FORCE_FETCH)
    find_package(PostgreSQL QUIET)
endif()
if (NOT PostgreSQL_FOUND)
    FetchContent_Declare(libpq
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(libpq)
    set(_libpq_resolved_via "fetch" CACHE INTERNAL "")
else()
    set(_libpq_resolved_via "system" CACHE INTERNAL "")
    message(STATUS "spice: libpq resolved via system find_package(PostgreSQL)")
endif()

# --- Generate spice-deps-manifest.json ---
set(_spice_manifest_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/spice-deps-manifest.json")
set(_spice_manifest "{\n")
set(_spice_first TRUE)

# manifest entry: libpq
if(NOT _spice_first)
  string(APPEND _spice_manifest ",\n")
endif()
set(_spice_first FALSE)
if(_libpq_resolved_via STREQUAL "system")
  set(_spice_libpq_inc "$<TARGET_PROPERTY:PostgreSQL::PostgreSQL,INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>")
  set(_spice_libpq_bld "")
else()
FetchContent_GetProperties(libpq)
if(EXISTS "${libpq_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
  set(_spice_libpq_inc "${libpq_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
else()
  set(_spice_libpq_inc "${libpq_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
set(_spice_libpq_bld "${libpq_BINARY_DIR}")
endif()
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "  \"libpq\": {\n"
  "    \"resolved_via\": \"${_libpq_resolved_via}\",\n"
  "    \"system_version\": \"${PostgreSQL_VERSION}\",\n"
)
if(_libpq_resolved_via STREQUAL "system")
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "    \"include_dirs\": [\"$<JOIN:$<TARGET_PROPERTY:PostgreSQL::PostgreSQL,INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>,\", \">\"],\n"
  "    \"link_dirs\":    [\"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:PostgreSQL::PostgreSQL>\"],\n"
  "    \"link_libs\":    [\"PostgreSQL\"]\n"
)
else()
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "    \"include_dirs\": [\"${_spice_libpq_inc}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_dirs\":    [\"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:PostgreSQL>\"],\n"
  "    \"link_libs\":    [\"PostgreSQL\"]\n"
)
endif()
string(APPEND _spice_manifest "  }")

string(APPEND _spice_manifest "\n}\n")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${_spice_manifest_path}" CONTENT "${_spice_manifest}")
message(STATUS "spice: will write cmake/spice-deps-manifest.json at generate time")
